section.title: Overview
section.para: Virtualization represents a foundational element in modern enterprise architecture. It allows you to consolidate hardware resources, reduce operational costs and simplify lifecycle management. &sles4sap; provides a highly optimized platform for you to virtualize demanding &sap; workloads using Kernel-based Virtual Machine (&kvm;) technology. By using &skvm;, you can run critical databases and application servers on a single high-performance physical server. This optimizes resource usage while maintaining strict security boundaries.

To ensure operational integrity, data safety and alignment with support policies, &sap; and &suse; conduct collaborative hypervisor validations. These validation processes ensure that your virtualized &sap; systems deliver near bare-metal performance, meeting strict performance criteria and minimizing virtualization latency across CPU, memory, storage and network subsystems. This reference document acts as your architectural guide, mapping out supported scenarios and validation requirements for both traditional and cloud-native deployments.
